entries.title: Four-entry property inline cache
surfaces: get_prop own-data reads
set_prop existing own-data writes
one-hop inherited observations
guards: exact receiver or holder Shape identity
plain non-array receiver for own slots
miss_behavior: perform the complete property operation
record only a valid shape-slot observation
replace secondary shapes round-robin after four identities
entries.metadata_lifetime: One InlineCache per bytecode instruction in the owning Chunk arena; observations remain warm for the Chunk lifetime and are advisory.
entries.no_gil_synchronization: Shared realms hold the object property lock around shape/slot use and publish cache fields with the InlineCache seqlock; a torn or contended snapshot is a miss.
entries.observable_steps_debugger: The shortcut stays inside one already-counted get_prop or set_prop dispatch; property quick kernels are disabled while statement debugging is active.

test_anchors.text: test "InlineCache retains four polymorphic shape-slot pairs"
test "InlineCache seqlock: concurrent writers never tear shape-slot pairs"

entries.title: Live global/environment binding cache
surfaces: load_var in an isolated VM execution
guards: exact global object and Shape for object-backed globals
live declarative binding lookup for environment-backed globals
miss_behavior: run lookupIdent/globalProp
replace the site cache only after complete resolution
decline caching for with and aliases
entries.metadata_lifetime: A lazily allocated instruction-indexed pointer table and QuickGlobalBinding records live in the Chunk arena.
entries.no_gil_synchronization: The cache is disabled when parallel_sync is true; shared execution performs locked Environment/property lookup instead of reading mutable cache records.
entries.observable_steps_debugger: A hit replaces only the load_var lookup inside its existing dispatch and preserves TDZ checks on the ordinary path.

test_anchors.text: test "vm: caches live global function bindings"

entries.title: Object-literal shape-transition cache
surfaces: fixed-name init_prop CreateDataPropertyOrThrow transitions
miss_behavior: run defineLiteralDataProp
record only the resulting direct child transition
computed/spread/accessor literal members stay generic
entries.metadata_lifetime: The literal-transition observation reuses the instruction InlineCache and lives with the Chunk arena.
entries.no_gil_synchronization: Shared lookups use the InlineCache seqlock and applyLiteralTransition performs the destination property synchronization.
entries.observable_steps_debugger: The cached transition implements the same single init_prop bytecode and method home-object setup remains outside the shortcut.

test_anchors.text: test "vm: fixed-name object literals cache shape transitions across realms"

entries.title: Bounded numeric property-update trace
surfaces: up to twenty bytecodes and eight numeric operations ending in set_prop
optional canonical counted-loop tail
guards: exact Shape and cached read/write slots
plain non-array target without proxy/accessor/attribute behavior
miss_behavior: resume ordinary bytecode at the same load_local
cache an unsupported sentinel only in isolated execution
a tail mismatch keeps the assignment-only trace
entries.metadata_lifetime: QuickPropertyPlan records are lazily arena allocated and instruction indexed; resolved slots are isolated-mode advisory state.
entries.no_gil_synchronization: Bounded per-assignment property traces are refused in parallel mode; shared execution uses ordinary synchronized property opcodes and inline caches.
entries.observable_steps_debugger: The plan records its exact executed bytecodes and advances the VM step budget; entry is disabled during debug execution and stops before checkpoints/budget exhaustion.

entries.title: Guarded indexed opcode fast paths
surfaces: present dense get_index, including present elements in holey array storage
primitive Number and canonical String sparse own-data get_index, replacement, and distant creation
ordinary prototype indexed dense or named-data get_index at arbitrary ancestor depth
existing dense set_index, including arrays with unrelated sparse data
guarded dense append, hole fill, and bounded gap growth
dense/sparse Array own-index creation through ordinary inherited writable data
primitive Number and canonical numeric String TypedArray get_index and set_index
primitive Number and canonical String mapped and unmapped arguments get_index and set_index
Array length read
Array.prototype data read
intrinsic Array.prototype.push call
guards: real Array, direct TypedArray, or direct arguments receiver
primitive Number or representation-specific canonical String key
live arguments mapping or synchronized dense arguments storage
coherent sparse named-own data descriptor, writable for replacements
absent exact own property, extensible Array, exact-key prototype permission, and distant index for sparse creation
requested dense reads must be present even when unrelated holes exist
extensible Array and exact-key prototype permission for dense creation
every nearer ancestor is ordinary and has no exact data/accessor; String, arguments, TypedArray, module, host, and Proxy boundaries remain generic
TypedArray String negative zero stays invalid; stores coerce before buffer revalidation
live in-bounds TypedArray view for element reads
nearest ordinary indexed data is writable; readonly/accessor/exotic holders retain canonical Set
miss_behavior: run ToPropertyKey and generic property/index semantics
dispatch the ordinary callable
never treat a hole or inherited indexed property as dense data
entries.metadata_lifetime: Array, TypedArray, and arguments index/length/push checks allocate no plan; prototype data reads use the instruction InlineCache for the Chunk lifetime.
entries.no_gil_synchronization: Shared reads use element/property snapshots, including indexed transactions across receiver/prototype dense and named state; inherited creation permission snapshots writability in indexed/property/element lock order; TypedArray backing-store locks and atomic arguments mapping cells cover their exotics; stores, dense/sparse creation, and appends use the corresponding object synchronization, and named prototype observations use the IC seqlock.
entries.observable_steps_debugger: Each shortcut remains within its already-counted opcode/call dispatch; observable coercion, proxy, accessor, and overridden-call cases miss before effects.

entries.title: Polymorphic property loop kernel
surfaces: one exact indexed-selector loop reading and writing named own data properties
miss_behavior: resume ordinary loop bytecode before any fused mutation
nonmatching bytecode uses the explicit unsupported array plan
entries.metadata_lifetime: The QuickPolymorphicPropertyLoop variant lives in the instruction-indexed Chunk-arena QuickArrayPlan.
entries.no_gil_synchronization: The plan is safely published, but the kernel currently requires isolated execution and therefore does not claim shared-realm coverage.
entries.observable_steps_debugger: The kernel advances exact bytecode steps within checkpoint/budget limits and is disabled for debug execution.

entries.title: Fixed-shape object-allocation loop kernel
surfaces: one exact selector/replacement loop allocating a three-property literal
guards: packed array and selected object state
managed allocation reserve and GC checkpoint contract
miss_behavior: return to the loop head before fused mutation
fall back after materializing state at GC/checkpoint boundaries
invalidate prepared shape state when the realm root Shape differs
entries.metadata_lifetime: The QuickArrayPlan lives in the Chunk arena; isolated prepared literal descriptors are keyed by the exact realm root Shape.
entries.no_gil_synchronization: Plan publication is atomic; shared execution locks frame/object/array state and crosses GC only from registered precise storage with the declared moving-safepoint protocol.
entries.observable_steps_debugger: The kernel preserves exact steps, termination checks, allocation failures, restricted-object errors, GC barriers, and statement-debugger exclusion.

test_anchors.text: test "vm: quickens fixed-shape object allocation loops with exact steps and guarded fallback"

entries.title: Bounded numeric leaf-call specialization
surfaces: straight-line numeric bytecode leaves
non-arrow static arguments[index] numeric expressions
captured scalar and receiver-property variants
guards: at most sixteen ops/eight stack values
no observable arguments mutation or escape
miss_behavior: perform the ordinary JS call
cache unsupported bytecode leaves explicitly
AST arguments leaves are revalidated for each exact call arity
entries.metadata_lifetime: QuickLeafPlan is lazily arena allocated per callee Chunk; the arguments-AST leaf is a bounded stack-local plan for one call.
entries.no_gil_synchronization: Callee plan publication uses acquire/release compare-exchange; captured frames and receiver properties use their owned synchronization.
entries.observable_steps_debugger: Leaf evaluation is disabled under statement hooks and advanceQuickObservableSteps preserves AST/bytecode steps, termination, GC, and GIL checkpoints.

test_anchors.text: test "vm: numeric call-loop quickening preserves guards and exact steps"

entries.title: Numeric leaf counted-call loop kernel
surfaces: exact counted loops calling a direct, method, closure-template, or arguments numeric leaf
guards: immutable or exactly guarded callee identity
miss_behavior: resume ordinary bytecode at the loop head
publish an explicit unsupported call-loop plan
entries.metadata_lifetime: Instruction-indexed QuickCallLoopPlan and per-callee QuickLeafPlan records live in their owning Chunk arenas.
entries.no_gil_synchronization: Both plans use acquire/release publication; frame, environment, receiver, and IC observations use their structure synchronization.
entries.observable_steps_debugger: The kernel calculates exact caller and callee steps, stops before checkpoints/budget, and is disabled when statement debugging is active.

test_anchors.text: test "vm: numeric call-loop quickening preserves guards and exact steps"

entries.title: Immediate-call closure reuse kernel
surfaces: checkpoint-spanning fallback iterations of the exact closure-template numeric call loop
guards: closure stored in the exact frame slot
same captured frame and callee Chunk
miss_behavior: allocate a fresh closure through makeClosure
never reuse when identity could escape or be observed
entries.metadata_lifetime: No additional metadata; it consumes the Chunk-arena call-loop and leaf plans plus the live frame slot.
entries.no_gil_synchronization: Plan publication is atomic and the candidate frame slot is read while holding the frame lock in shared execution.
entries.observable_steps_debugger: Reuse occurs only where the exact immediate-call pattern proves closure identity unobservable; all other make_closure dispatches remain ordinary.

test_anchors.text: test "vm: numeric call-loop quickening preserves guards and exact steps"

entries.title: Adaptive Number binary dispatch
surfaces: add/subtract/multiply/divide/remainder/power
relational and equality comparisons
bitwise operations and shifts
guards: exact Number representation for both operands
in remains generic because its RHS must be Object
miss_behavior: record both changed operand kinds
atomically publish terminal generic state
execute the canonical operation exactly once without replaying coercion or exceptions
entries.metadata_lifetime: One byte-sized atomic QuickBinaryState per immutable bytecode instruction, colocated with that instruction's operand-kind optimizer profile in the owning Chunk arena; non-binary slots stay cold and teardown requires no separate reclamation.
entries.no_gil_synchronization: The state tag publishes no associated data, so hot mode reads use monotonic atomic modification order while observation/publication/dequickening remain atomic and generic is terminal under every interleaving. Activation-local attribution counts merge once into Context-owned atomics.
entries.observable_steps_debugger: A hit replaces only one already-counted binary opcode. Debugger, watchdog, handler/finally, OOM, and moving-GC boundaries remain in the ordinary dispatch loop; a miss performs no coercion before canonical fallback.

test_anchors.text: test "quick binary generic publication wins concurrent Number observations"
test "Number-specialized misses dequicken once without replaying coercion or throws"

entries.title: Guarded native numeric-leaf call entry
surfaces: ordinary call of a ready baseline/optimizing numeric leaf without heap activation construction
guards: no class constructor or arguments object
published artifact has matching frame layout and no side exits
miss_behavior: build/run the ordinary VM activation or generic call
a managed native miss/deoptimization never becomes a completed direct call
entries.metadata_lifetime: It consumes the callee Chunk native-tier artifacts; the temporary bounded slot array lives only for the call.
entries.no_gil_synchronization: Native tier artifacts use their own atomic publication/invalidation contract; the call copies arguments into private stack storage and rechecks execution permission.
entries.observable_steps_debugger: Statement hooks forbid direct entry; managed artifacts own exact step/trap accounting and unmanaged artifacts are admitted only under the existing native observability contract.
